what: When a section (panel) enters within 100px of the screen bottom, it rises from 100px below into place over 1s ease-out. When it leaves the screen (beyond 100px above or below), it drops back 100px and rises again. Use it for section transitions where rounded panels overlap and rise over the previous panel. It does not fade, it only moves.

options.margin: Off-screen margin (px) — IntersectionObserver rootMargin top and bottom, default 100
options.once: If true, once it has risen it does not go back down (by default it drops each time it leaves)
options.--fx-dur · --fx-ease: Duration and curve (via style), default 1s ease-out

from.where: index.html every Section .bm-sheet (original .slide-on-scroll: translateY(100px) → 0, transition transform 1s ease-out, IO rootMargin 100px 0px, is-visible removed on exit)
